@graph.name: The Aetas Impact System
@graph.description: One operating model for building organisational and financial resilience in purpose-led organisations: measure the risk, build resilience, sustain the mission — across four drivers and measured by the Mission Resilience Index.

@graph.name: Mission Resilience Index (MRI)
@graph.description: A single benchmarked score, from 0 to 100, measuring a purpose-led organisation's resilience across the four drivers of the Aetas Impact System: Financial Resilience, Financial Education, People & Wellbeing and Organisational Capability. Established at the Impact Review and tracked over time.
